text:
Anya (Design): Quick pattern question: propose collapsing sections in the left rail into three groups (Workspace / Product / Tools) and adding a small deep-link affordance on each leaf. Copy icon appears on hover & focus. Feedback?
Mike (Eng): Nice for density, but worried about hidden items becoming hard to find. also routing: how do we handle resources that are accessible from multiple parents without duplicating canonical URLs?
Anya (Design): Plan is a single canonical route per resource (e.g., /models/:id). If arriving from another area we show a contextual pill in the breadcrumb like "via Pipelines" rather than a different canonical path.
Jess (PM): Customers often paste links into tickets. canonical link must always land on the same tab. So canonical route wins. context param is fine for analytics but shouldn't change canonical landing state.
Sam (Frontend): Accessibility/keyboard question: hover affordance needs an equivalent for keyboard users. Suggest focus-visible button and a small action menu with Copy/Open. Also debounce the toast so it doesn't flash.
Kai (Accessibility): The deep-link action must be keyboard tabbable, have an aria-label (e.g., "Copy link to Model details"), and not rely only on color or tooltip. Breadcrumb separators should be aria-hidden and we should expose the full crumb via screen reader text.
Mike (Eng): Implementation thought: use a query param for context: /models/:id?from=workflows. canonical URL is /models/:id. We keep canonical deterministic. OK?
Jess (PM): Works for product. Ensure analytics captures the from param, but we also need to strip ephemeral params from shared links (session, tracking ids).
Anya (Design): UX: when ?from= exists show a subtle pill next to breadcrumbs titled "via Workflows" with an x to dismiss (which removes param via history.replaceState).
Sam (Frontend): Implementation sketch:
```js
function copyDeepLink() {
  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  // remove ephemeral params
  const allowlist = ['from', 'lang'];
  for (const p of Array.from(url.searchParams.keys())) {
    if (!allowlist.includes(p)) url.searchParams.delete(p);
  }
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(url.toString());
  showToast('Link copied');
}
```
strip tokens, ephemeral flags.
routing-bot: created PR checklist for stable params: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/merge-templates#deep-link-params :robot_face:
Kai (Accessibility): For keyboard, when nav item receives focus, show a small kbd-friendly menu (Enter opens, context menu has Copy link). Focus should be managed so screenreader users can access actions.
Sam (Frontend): Reuse existing popover. Ensure popover trapping and restore focus after close. Add tests for keyboard sequence and screen reader announcement for copy success.
Anya (Design): Visual: small link icon (16px) appears on hover/focus. On copy show a 200ms checkmark animation. Maintain contrast. On mobile collapse into item overflow menu.
Mike (Eng): Flagging mobile: hide inline deep-link on narrow widths; keep action in overflow. Also add feature flag for rollout.
Jess (PM): Rollout: 10% internal -> measure copy rate, successful opens, and support ticket links. Watch for discoverability regressions.
Sam (Frontend): I'll prototype the component PR with aria-labels and demo page. Include analytics events for direct copy and open-in-new-tab.
Anya (Design): I'll update the spec with aria labels, micro-interaction, and copy variants for tooltips. Sync next Wed 10:30.
Mike (Eng): Sounds good. I'll draft a short RFC once Sam's PR is ready.
Kai (Accessibility): No blockers from a11y. Please include high-zoom/contrast testing.
Jess (PM): Thanks everyone. Adding notes to the roadmap doc and linking the PR checklist. :thumbsup:
Anya (Design): Closing thread. Ping me if you want to pair on edge cases.
